params.body:
## What

The strength number leaves gentells.com. In its place:

- **Momentum in words.** The direction of the trend's record (rules/recurrence.json#direction): Rising (in coral), Steady, Easing, Too new to tell. It's shown on the card, the row and the detail page. `TrendCard::momentumWord()` reads it from the record the projection already sends.
- **An evidence line that says what was checked.** `TrendCard::evidenceLine()`:
  - "Holds: borne out by 4 signals from 5 sources, 2 more in part";
  - "A lead: borne out by 1 signal from 8 sources, 10 more in part";
  - while nothing is judged, "Seen in 84 signals from 40 sources, not yet checked against its claim".
- **The ticker drops its "+78".** A trend whose record is rising says "rising"; the others carry no figure.
- **The notes are rewritten.** "About momentum" on /trends and the home ticker note now say what the words mean.
- **Data.** `trend_cards.support` (json, nullable, new migration) is filled by `Projection::reconcileTrends` from the pipeline's new `support` field (gentells-pipeline #340). Until the pipeline sends it, every card reads "not yet checked", so either side can deploy first.

## Why

The site showed `strength` as "Momentum", explained as "the spread velocity of a signal ... within a time window", where "a score of 90+ indicates rapid cross-cultural diffusion". Strength has no window and no rate, and in practice never passes 85: it is how much evidence a trend stands on. Gentells Standard 0.10.0 (#display) names the direction of the record as momentum and forbids showing strength as momentum, velocity or with a plus sign.

The count under it misled too. On the first trends the pipeline judged (14 October 2026), between 57 and 73 of 62 to 84 signals under a trend shared a theme with it but said something else. "Backed by 84 signals" read as evidence. The new line counts only the signals judged to bear the claim out.

## Not changed, to decide

- `resources/legal/terms-en.md` still says "Momentum indicators express the spread of a signal across unconnected sources, regions and subcultures within a time window." That is contract text, so it is left for Trendwolves to reword.
- The agent door (`Access/Shapes.php`, `Reader.php`) still returns `strength`, under that name, not as momentum.
- On the detail page, "+N more signals feed this trend" and the signal sample still count every signal, related or not. Showing supporting signals first is a follow-up.

## Tests

- New `tests/Feature/MomentumInWordsTest.php`: the direction on the card, no strength number and no "90+", the unjudged line, a lead, a trend that holds on its detail page, and the ticker without "+78".
- `EvidenceKindsTest` expects the new line instead of "Built from 71 signals".
- Full suite on the workbench: 440 of 442. One failure is `BuildStampTest`, which fails in any worktree. The other is the `EvidenceKindsTest` expectation, updated above and green on rerun. `pint --test` passes.
- Rendered locally against the dev projection with directions and verdicts filled in, at desktop and phone width, before proposing.
params.title: Momentum in words, and evidence that says which signals bear a trend out
